mapper.update: update pmhub_project_file set deleted = 1, deleted_time = #{deletedTime}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_time = #{updatedTime} where id = #{id} and deleted = 0
mapper.select:
select f.id as fileId, f.project_id, f.pt_id, f.type, f.file_name, f.extension, f.file_url, f.path_name, f.file_size, f.user_id, su.nick_name, f.created_time from pmhub_project_file f left join sys_user su on su.user_id = f.user_id where f.deleted = 0
and f.pt_id = #{data.id} and f.type = #{data.type}
and f.project_id = #{data.id} and f.type in ('project', 'task')
and f.file_name like concat('%', #{data.fileName}, '%')
order by f.created_time desc
